_comment: Engine config for brain.js. owner_name: how notes and messages name you; owner_key: the task `owner:` value that means you; agent_owners: the other allowed owners. code_root: where new project folders are created. scan_roots/scan_ignore: folder scan for code no note mentions. work_roots/work_keywords: the wall — hooks stay silent and importers skip when a session or chat is work. projects: keywords for the classifier and the chat importer (name and alias matches score 3, keywords 1). scheduled_tasks: which area's Run Log a Claude scheduled task reports to. pipeline_prompts: regexes for the first prompt of headless pipeline calls (claude -p); sweep and import skip them. away_root: optional second-machine drop clone; empty turns the feature off. Edit freely; the script reads this every run.
